fichas.title: British standards for building physics and finishings
fichas.summary: Reference list of British Standards covering thermal insulation, thermal and hygrothermal performance, thermal bridges, chimneys, building hardware, lifts, lighting, daylighting, building air permeability, windows and doors, shutters, glass blocks, gutters, and gypsum-board partitions and dry linings.
uses: Reference British standards for building design, specification, construction, and performance
